errors.description: Model incorrectly identified yellow appearing on top of cubes during rolls, despite ground truth showing yellow never appeared on top after any roll.
errors.evidence_quote: Model trace: 'In one instance, yellow appears on the top of the middle cube. In another instance, yellow appears on the top of the right cube.'

analysis_result.analysis: The model hallucinated two instances of yellow appearing on top of cubes during the rolling sequence, contradicting the ground truth which explicitly lists the top-face colors for all 5 rolls across 3 cubes — none of which include yellow. This is a clear perception error where the model assigned an incorrect attribute (color) to the cubes' top faces, likely due to misinterpreting the initial static cube configuration (where Cube 3 had yellow on top at 0:10) as an actual roll outcome. The model failed to distinguish between the initial state and the dynamic roll results.
